description: A response of POST /api/v1/portfolio/execution-plan recorded on 2026-11-24 from a local server reading Base mainnet and the live KyberSwap API, with the recorded local registry of the web app tests. Unchanged.

data.statement: Executable quotes from a third-party aggregator, checked against reference prices and the chain at one block. Each swap returns at least its minimum amount out or reverts; more than the minimum is not guaranteed. The plan must be quoted again after expiresAt, and it is not an instruction to trade.
